provenance.origin: Publication-safe scenarios written from documented JVM, Spring, Kafka and database failure semantics; no user or production logs were collected.
provenance.labelingMethod: Expected outcomes and rationales are stored in the dataset before evaluation. Detector output is never used to create or rewrite a label.
limitations: The corpus is synthetic and does not estimate production-wide accuracy.
A maintainer should review labels when cases or supported diagnostics change.
Ambiguous and cross-subsystem cases intentionally stress broad token matching.
